title: The Fox and the Crane
moral: When you think about how your friend feels, everyone has a good time.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본. text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, new 만 새로 녹음한다(trim 없음). 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.set:<forest|kitchen|high|pondhouse|crane: 장면 배경(bgImage 키, split = 부엌·두루미 방 반반). scenes[].set 으로 자동 호출
acts.cut:<peck|lick|stuck|sorry>: 그림 컷 4장 — 컷 속 외침(VOICE_LINES cut_peck·cut_lick·cut_stuck)은 그대로 재사용

lines.text: 숲속에 여우랑 두루미가 살았어요.
lines.en: In the forest lived a fox and a crane.
segs: In the forest lived a fox and a crane.

lines.text: 여우는 꼬리가 복슬복슬, 두루미는 다리가 길쭉길쭉했어요.
lines.en: Fox had a big, fluffy tail, and Crane had long, long legs.
segs: Fox had a big, fluffy tail, and Crane had long, long legs.

lines.text: 여우가 초대장을 가져왔어요.
lines.en: Fox brought an invitation.

lines.text: "두루미야, 내일 우리 집에 밥 먹으러 와!"
lines.en: Crane, come to my house for dinner tomorrow!
segs: Crane, come to my house for dinner tomorrow!

lines.text: "와, 고마워!" 두루미가 긴 다리로 폴짝 뛰었어요.
lines.en: "Wow, thank you!" Crane hopped up on those long legs.
segs: Crane hopped up on those long legs.

lines.text: "좋아, 여우야! 내일 꼭 갈게!"
lines.en: Of course, Fox! I will be there tomorrow!
segs: Of course, Fox! I will be there tomorrow!

lines.text: 여우가 맛있는 수프를 끓여요.
lines.en: Fox is cooking some yummy soup.
segs: Fox is cooking some yummy soup.

lines.text: 여우는 꼬리를 살랑살랑 흔들며 콧노래를 흥얼흥얼 불렀어요.
lines.en: Fox wagged that fluffy tail, swish, swish, and hummed a happy little tune.
segs: Fox wagged that fluffy tail, swish, swish, and hummed a happy little tune.

lines.text: 보글보글, 구수한 냄새가 솔솔 퍼졌어요.
lines.en: Bubble, bubble! A warm, tasty smell drifted all through the kitchen.
segs: Bubble, bubble! A warm, tasty smell drifted all through the kitchen.

lines.text: 여우는 커다란 국자로 수프를 휘휘 저었어요.
lines.en: Fox stirred the soup round and round with a great big ladle.
segs: Fox stirred the soup round and round with a great big ladle.

lines.text: 여우가 킥킥 웃어요. "납작 접시에 담아야지~"
lines.en: Fox giggles. "I'll serve it on a flat plate~"
segs: I'll serve it on a flat plate~

lines.text: 두루미가 놀러 왔어요. 그런데 접시가 아주 납작해요!
lines.en: Crane came to visit. But the plate is very flat!
segs: Crane came to visit. But the plate is very flat!

lines.text: 두루미는 긴 부리를 접시에 콕, 콕, 딱딱 부딪쳐 보았어요.
lines.en: Crane poked at the plate with that long beak. Peck, peck, clack, clack!
segs: Crane poked at the plate with that long beak. Peck, peck, clack, clack!

lines.text: 어머나, 부리 끝만 딱딱 닿아요. 수프를 먹을 수가 없어요.
lines.en: Oh dear, only the tip of the beak goes clack, clack. Crane can't eat the soup.
segs: Oh dear, only the tip of the beak goes clack, clack. Crane can't eat the soup.

lines.text: 여우는 혀로 핥핥, 다 먹었어요. 두루미는 배가 꼬르륵, 속상했어요.
lines.en: Fox licked, lick lick, and ate it all up. Crane's tummy rumbled, and Crane felt sad.
segs: Fox licked, lick lick, and ate it all up. Crane's tummy rumbled, and Crane felt sad.

lines.text: 두루미는 고개를 푹 숙이고 터덜터덜 집으로 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: Crane hung that long neck down low and trudged slowly home, plod, plod.
segs: Crane hung that long neck down low and trudged slowly home, plod, plod.

lines.text: 며칠 뒤, 이번엔 두루미가 여우를 불렀어요.
lines.en: A few days later, Crane invited Fox over.
segs: A few days later, Crane invited Fox over.

lines.text: "여우야, 우리 집에도 놀러 와~"
lines.en: "Fox, come over to my house too~"
segs: "Fox, come over to my house too~"

lines.text: 두루미는 목이 긴 병에 수프를 콸콸 부어 두었어요.
lines.en: Crane poured the soup into a tall, thin bottle, glug, glug, glug.
segs: Crane poured the soup into a tall, thin bottle, glug, glug, glug.

lines.text: 여우가 신이 났어요. "좋아! 맛있는 거 먹어야지!"
lines.en: Fox was so excited. "Yay! I'm going to eat something yummy!"
segs: Yay! I'm going to eat something yummy!

lines.text: 여우는 꼬리를 살랑살랑 흔들며 총총 달려갔어요.
lines.en: Fox wagged that fluffy tail, swish, swish, and trotted off, trot, trot.
segs: Fox wagged that fluffy tail, swish, swish, and trotted off, trot, trot.

lines.text: 와, 병이 탑처럼 높아요! 목이 아주 길어요.
lines.en: Wow, the bottle is as tall as a tower! The neck is so long.
segs: Wow, the bottle is as tall as a tower!

lines.text: 여우는 긴 병을 요리조리, 빙글빙글 돌려 보았어요.
lines.en: Fox turned the tall bottle this way and that, round and round.
segs: Fox turned the tall bottle this way and that, round and round.

lines.text: 여우는 코를 킁킁, 병 속에 코를 쏙 넣어 보았어요.
lines.en: Fox sniffed, sniff, sniff, and poked that nose right into the bottle.
segs: Fox sniffed, sniff, sniff, and poked that nose right into the bottle.

lines.text: 어머나! 여우 코가 병에 쏙 끼었어요!
lines.en: Oh no! Fox's nose got stuck in the bottle!
segs: Oh no! Fox's nose got stuck in the bottle!

lines.text: 뿅! 코가 빠졌어요. 엉덩방아 쿵!
lines.en: Pop! The nose came out. Fox landed with a thump!
segs: Pop! The nose came out. Fox landed with a thump!

lines.text: 두루미는 긴 부리로 쪽쪽 먹었어요. 여우는 배가 꼬르륵, 속상했어요.
lines.en: Crane sipped with that long beak, sip, sip. Fox's tummy rumbled, and Fox felt sad.
segs: Crane sipped with that long beak, sip, sip. Fox's tummy rumbled, and Fox felt sad.

lines.text: 둘 다 못 먹었어요. 왜 그랬을까요?
lines.en: Neither of them could eat. Why was that?
segs: Neither of them could eat. Why was that?

lines.text: 두루미 부리는 길쭉길쭉, 납작한 접시에는 콕콕 닿지 않아요.
lines.en: Crane's beak is long and thin. On a flat plate it just goes peck, peck, and reaches nothing.
segs: Crane's beak is long and thin. On a flat plate it just goes peck, peck, and reaches nothing.

lines.text: 여우 입은 짧고 혀로 핥핥, 목이 긴 병에는 쏙 들어가지 않지요.
lines.en: Fox's mouth is short and licks, lick, lick. It can't fit down a long bottle neck.
segs: Fox's mouth is short and licks, lick, lick. It can't fit down a long bottle neck.

lines.text: 둘은 서로의 입 모양을 가만가만 들여다보았어요.
lines.en: Quietly, the two of them looked closely at each other's mouths.
segs: Quietly, the two of them looked closely at each other's mouths.

lines.text: 여우랑 두루미가 함께 잔치를 열었어요. 손님들도 와요!
lines.en: Fox and Crane are having a feast together. The guests are coming too!
segs: Fox and Crane are having a feast together. The guests are coming too!

lines.text: 꽥꽥! 오리가 뒤뚱뒤뚱, 팔랑팔랑! 나비가 사뿐사뿐 날아왔어요.
lines.en: Quack, quack! Duck came waddling in, and flutter, flutter! Butterfly came floating down.
segs: Quack, quack! Duck came waddling in, and flutter, flutter! Butterfly came floating down.

lines.text: 두루미에게는 긴 병, 여우에게는 납작 접시, 오리에게는 넓은 그릇, 나비에게는 꽃!
lines.en: A tall bottle for Crane, a flat plate for Fox, a wide bowl for Duck, and a flower for Butterfly!
segs: A tall bottle for Crane, a flat plate for Fox, a wide bowl for Duck, and a flower for Butterfly!

lines.text: 모두 자기한테 딱 맞는 그릇을 받고 싱글벙글 웃었어요.
lines.en: Everyone got a dish that was just right for them, and they all beamed with joy.
segs: Everyone got a dish that was just right for them, and they all beamed with joy.

lines.text: 등불이 반짝, 모두 모여 잔치를 해요.
lines.en: The lanterns twinkle, and everyone gathers for the feast.
segs: The lanterns twinkle, and everyone gathers for the feast.

lines.text: 여우가 말했어요. "두루미야, 미안해."
lines.en: Fox said, "I'm sorry, Crane."

lines.text: 두루미도 말했어요. "여우야, 나도 미안해."
lines.en: Crane said, "I'm sorry too, Fox."

lines.text: "괜찮아!" 둘은 다시 사이좋은 친구가 되었어요.
lines.en: "It's okay!" The two became good friends again.
segs: The two became good friends again.

lines.text: 쪽쪽, 핥핥, 냠냠! 모두 맛있게 먹었어요.
lines.en: Slurp, slurp! Lick, lick! Yum, yum! Everyone ate happily.
segs: Slurp, slurp! Lick, lick! Yum, yum! Everyone ate happily.

lines.text: 배부르게 먹고, 모두 행복하게 웃었답니다.
lines.en: They ate until they were full, and everyone smiled happily.
segs: They ate until they were full, and everyone smiled happily.

lines.text: 오리는 꽥꽥, 나비는 팔랑팔랑, 잔치는 밤늦도록 이어졌어요.
lines.en: Duck went quack, quack, Butterfly went flutter, flutter, and the feast went on late into the night.
segs: Duck went quack, quack, Butterfly went flutter, flutter, and the feast went on late into the night.

lines.text: 친구 입장이 되어 보면 모두 즐겁답니다.
lines.en: When you think about how your friend feels, everyone has a good time.
segs: When you think about how your friend feels, everyone has a good time.
